units.source_text: “从发展趋势来看，整个京都城可能用不了多久，

en.t: Judging from the trend of development, before long the whole city of Kyoto may

units.source_text: 就像高台寺一带那样，都要盖起饭店旅馆啦……

en.t: end up like the area around Kodaiji, with restaurants, hotels, and inns built everywhere...

units.source_text: 大阪、京都之间变成了工业区，

en.t: The area between Osaka and Kyoto has turned into an industrial zone,

units.source_text: 西京 [2] 一带交通不便，这倒还好，

en.t: and around Saikyo [2] the transportation is inconvenient, which is still not so bad,

units.source_text: 但那附近还有空地，谁又能保证今后不在那附近盖起怪里怪气的时新房子呢……”

en.t: but there is still open land nearby, so who can guarantee that strange, newfangled houses will not be built there in the future..."
